attchmntText: Kaushalya Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Kaushalya Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited published its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial statements for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 in the Business Standard and Arthik Lipi. B & A Packaging India Limited reported a net profit of 79.24 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to 317.54 lakhs in the previous year. Agarwal Industrial Corporation Limited reported a standalone net profit of 1,110.75 lakhs and a consolidated net profit of 1,554.23 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Dhunseri Investments Limited reported a net profit of 113 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026.

attchmntText: Kaushalya Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kaushalya Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited submitted its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 13, 2026, following review by the Audit Committee. The standalone total income for the year ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 108.55 lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 51.71 lakhs. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, standalone total income was Rs. 15.24 lakhs, and profit after tax was Rs. 10.06 lakhs. The consolidated results for the year ended September 30, 2026, showed a profit after tax of Rs. 30.29 lakhs. The review report by KASG & Co. stated that nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements in the financial statements prepared under Ind AS 34.

attchmntText: Kaushalya Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Kaushalya Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited has disclosed the sudden demise of Mr. Bira Kishore Barik, Proprietor of M/s. B. K. Barik & Associates, who served as the company's Secretarial Auditor. Mr. Barik passed away on November 6, 2026. The company received this information on November 9, 2026. The announcement was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company expressed grief and appreciated his long-standing association and professional contributions during his tenure. This disclosure is submitted to the BSE and NSE. The stock code for Kaushalya is 532925.
